reference.title: Study of the drug-drug interaction between simvastatin and cisapride in man.
reference.abstract: The concomitant administration of the prokinetic agent cisapride and the 3-hydroxy-3-methylgluaryl CoA reductase inhibitor simvastatin resulted in altered pharmacokinetics of both drugs. Increased plasma concentrations of cisapride suggest that some patients may be at risk of toxicity while receiving both drugs, whereas the decrease in simvastatin acid plasma concentrations suggests that cholesterol lowering effects of simvastatin treatment may be blunted.
